text:
infra-bot: ALERT: hosted-api us-east-1 queue growth detected (p95 > 2s, p99 > 8s) — backlog rising from 20k -> 120k in 12m, error rate 5%. paging oncall: ops_oncall

ops_oncall: I'm on it. what triggered? any customer reports?

sre_andy: seeing a sudden traffic blast from partner 'QuickShip' — spikes tied to promo campaign, request rate x12 typical for their tenant. Queue depth correlation looks strong.

paige_prod: support_lead is getting inbound ticket stream — several customers reporting timeouts and 503s. priority: impact to paid users on Hosted API.

support_lead: yup escalations from 3 enterprise customers. One is hitting 10% failed requests. Sharing logs via link: https://internal.redwood/ops/logs/516789

samir_ml: autoscaler logs show repeated failures during instance creation: 
```
ERROR: VMProvisioner: CreateInstance failed: quotaExceeded
CausedBy: InstanceCreateRateExceeded
TraceID: a1b2c3
```
We tried to spawn smaller instances but rate limits prevented new GPUs.

ops_oncall: autoscaler stuck in backoff, controller failing to get capacity. GPU pool utilization at 99.6% across us-east-1. Evictions starting for best-effort worker pools.

sre_andy: immediate mitigation plan: 1) enable tenant-level rate limiting for QuickShip to curb inflow 2) route non-critical model variants to CPU fallback 3) enable canary routing to dedicated reserved pool for enterprise tenants 4) open emergency quota with cloud provider. I'll start 1 & 2 now.

paige_prod: +1 do we have a playbook for emergency quota requests? rebecca_pm: I can file but need justification numbers.

rebecca_pm: filing request now — including metric dumps and customer impact. ETA from cloud portal ~ 1-2 hours (best case).

ops_oncall: rolling out soft throttles to QuickShip: 
```
POST /internal/admin/rate_limit
{ "tenant": "quickship", "rps": 60, "burst": 120 }
```
Applied. Observing immediate reduction in inbound rate to 3x baseline.

infra-bot: ACTION: quickship throttled by ops_oncall — reaction :thumbsup: from 2 users

samir_ml: pushing routing change: send non-realtime requests to cpu-fallback model variant (gpt-small-ql8) via policy 'degrade-medium' — reduces GPU pressure by ~28% per our sim.

ops_oncall: applied routing policy; logs: 
```
INFO: route-change applied: /v1/generate -> model=gpt-small-ql8 for tenant=quickship filter=non-critical
```

support_lead: support update posted to affected customers: "We are investigating increased errors in Hosted API; mitigation steps in progress; ETA updates in channel."

sre_andy: despite throttles and routing, backlog only stabilized, not shrinking. Autoscaler still failing due to quota. We need an intermediate capacity plan to reduce p99.

paige_prod: can we temporarily reassign some Dedicated capacity from internal pools to Hosted? Any org-level reserved GPUs we can borrow?

ops_oncall: quick inventory: one Dedicated pool (dedicated-eu-1) has unused headroom (10 GPUs) but in eu-1 region — cross-region latency for some customers but acceptable as temporary failover for non-region-locked tenants.

sre_andy: spinning up cross-region routing for non-region-locked tenants to route a fraction of requests to eu-1 dedicated pool. Implementing as staged rollout (10% -> 30% -> 60%).

ops_oncall: executing staged reroute: step1 10% applied. Monitoring p95/p99.

infra-bot: METRIC: p95 latency dropped from 2.1s -> 1.4s after 10% reroute. p99 still high at 6.5s.

samir_ml: recommend aggressive KV prefix caching for repeated QuickShip payloads — can shave token costs and runtime. Deploying cache rules now.

ops_oncall: cache rule live. Observing duplicate prefix cache hits rising from 2% -> 22%. Helpful.

cloud_ops_bot: UPDATE: Cloud provider acknowledgment received for quota request. They requested additional telemetry and business justification. Response window now ~45m.

rebecca_pm: I've sent follow-up justification including customer SLAs and revenue impact screenshots.

support_lead: customers updated. One enterprise engaged account manager directly; they're satisfied with temporary reroute note.

sre_andy: small wins but p99 still problematic for a subset of requests that require large context lengths. We should force smaller context windows for non-critical requests. Samir, can model accept max_tokens reduction gracefully?

samir_ml: yes — pushing policy to cap max_tokens to 512 for degraded routing. That will reduce GPU OOM/long-run tasks. Implementing now.

ops_oncall: cap in place. Long-run tasks are throttled; backlog aged requests (>30s) are being canceled per policy to free slots. Posting cancel command: 
```
POST /internal/queue/cancel_aged?age=30
```
Canceled ~2.4k aged requests.

infra-bot: NOTIFICATION: canceled aged requests (2403) — backlog reduced.

sre_andy: p95 now ~1.2s, p99 ~3.6s. Error rate down to 1.2%. Still not ideal but operational.

ops_oncall: handoff check — my shift ends in 40m. If cloud quota doesn't arrive before then, need ops_oncall2 to be ready for escalation.

paige_prod: coordinating on-call swap. ops_oncall2 is being paged.

ops_oncall2: I'm up. summary?

ops_oncall: Quick summary for ops_oncall2: traffic spike from QuickShip x12; throttled tenant; non-critical traffic rerouted to cpu-fallback and eu-1 dedicated pool staged 10%->; KV caching enabled; capped max_tokens=512; canceled aged requests; cloud quota pending (45m). p95 1.2s p99 3.6s. error rate 1.2%.

ops_oncall2: got it. I'll watch autoscaler logs and be ready to reassign more dedicated capacity if needed. Also prepared to increase reroute to 30% on your call.

rebecca_pm: customer impact note: 3 enterprise customers reported degraded performance during window 5167890123 - 5167890800. Revenue exposure estimate ~ $2.6k/hr. Filing incident report after stabilization.

sre_andy: once cloud quota confirmed, autoscaler should drain backlog and we can lift throttles gradually. After stabilization: retro items — improve autoscaler error classification (quota vs other), add preflight quota checks for tenants with scheduled promos, build quick borrow plan for Dedicated pools.

support_lead: complete postmortem checklist assigned to rebecca_pm and samir_ml.

infra-bot: RESOLUTION: cloud quota approved at 5167890684 — autoscaler succeeded in provisioning 18 GPUs. backlog drained over next 18m.

ops_oncall2: verified provisioning. p95 -> 0.45s p99 -> 0.9s, error rate -> 0.1%. Lifting soft throttle to QuickShip in stages.

paige_prod: sending customer closure communication. Great work team.

rebecca_pm: postmortem draft assigned — will link in this thread when ready.

sre_andy: notes for postmortem: timeline, mitigation steps, exact metric improvements, cloud request text, and recommended runbook changes.

ops_oncall2: handing back to normal ops. Closing active pager.

infra-bot: THREAD CLOSED: incident mitigated; follow-up tasks assigned."
